title: Code for: Observation-conditioned bounds define experimental decision criteria for bifunctional enzyme systems
description: Reproducible code, source measurement summaries, numerical results, figures and manuscript sources for Observation-conditioned bounds define experimental decision criteria for bifunctional enzyme systems. Version 1.4.0 adds a general positive-polynomial graph enclosure, a second application to AceK–IDH including doubly enzyme-bound target complexes, six published kinetic summaries and three withheld ATPase halfpoint checks. Expanded raw-assay calibration uses 3,000 trials per null setting and 2,000 per independent evaluation setting, with 8,016,000 nonlinear fits across two paired fitting strategies. Concentration decisions are prospective conditional criteria; matched native-assay certification is not claimed. Independent verification reports and source provenance are included. Original code is MIT licensed; the retained Gosztolai et al. workbook and model retain CC BY 4.0 attribution. Primary literature PDFs are not redistributed.
